content: Yon ikayeb navamul inekes Yeisuw
Yeisuw anilivan towen, imulis nagamag tasiyas sinawatan teiy. Imulis ikous, inoun in ven babaw, ikatimlakes gamag babaw, igeiguy.

Misumkwey towen Yon nises wa̱deil, mtowen tabibapta̱ysein gamags, butun Yeisuw inawotet iligen, ikayeb navamul mwasanin inekes Yeisuw, ikatugans, ilansa, “Yowbad bikayeb Mesay beim, mtowen ya̱koum? o nag? tabta teitan bakakayamat igaw beim wankuyeim?”

Yeisuw ikatimop asilivan, ilana, “Kuneis, kwatimlakes Yon sinap towen nukukines o kuliganes; magina toukwaws mites bo ikiplal, takagayals bo inounas bwein, toulepels bo ibwein kalivis, tasiyas ituy tiges bo iliganes livan, takanigs bo ikits mwasanin, o tasiyas tasimavs inganegs Yowbad anilivan bwanabwein. Kal yak bukusimounid gunawotet waseg, tage ta-kupiyaveig, igaw mo bukumwa̱saw.”
Iyums tasiyas, Yeisuw mo ikatiga̱nes gamag babaw peinan Yon, ilana, “Kweiboug kuneis wanawoud, aveiyag silma̱nin bukukines? Bukukines kay iguwen yag, ne?
“O bukukines gamag teitan anakweim mwaynamnabwein ne? Nag, adok tasiyas nisesus guyawaw wasibunatum.
“Tage, kuneis kukines palopit teitan. Mounid mtowen Yon nimgwayes palopit wasigeis.
“Peinan liva̱nen Yon nises, magina Yowbad anilivan nidibek Mesay, palopit mo ilel Bukitab waseg mamagina:
Yeisuw mo ilana, “Mounid adibakeimiy nag kal nikop ven watinow ikalsow mtowen Yon, peinan Yon ikalsawes gamag babaw; tage Yowbad nakaleiwag kweivaw waseg asibabaw ikalsawes Yon.
“Misiya̱mun Yon inawotet waseg, tasiyas tatawtouns sivines Yowbad nakaleiwag, isilamaws sitawtoun waseg iyyousis ee... nagein bo ma̱wan.
“Tut kweiboug Moses nakaleiwag o tasiyas palopit, Yowbad nakaleiwag isekes gamag wasigeis ee... wankuyeim mo isap Yon.
“Kukin sivinamiy bukuliganes agulivan towen mo bukukwakins kavel Yon. Towen Ilaytiy va̱gan bikidumwal Mesay inaked, mtowen mounid Yon.
“Yakamiy tigamiy sam bweina kuliganes.”

Yeisuw mo ilivan, ilana, “Ama̱wan bakabebay mo bukukwakins amisinap? Adok yakamiy mamagina gamagal iwliwals wavtakon ven, idibakes sisiyas, ilansa, ‘Kawaway kup, tage nag kusilasals; ikous mo kalloupid, tage nag kuva̱lams.’

“Peinan Yon isap, nag ikamkwam; na-imoum wayn, mo kulansa, ‘Takabala̱wein towen, peinan baloum iweiy.’ Gimgilitoun yey mo asap, akamkwam, amwamoum, mogo kulansa, ‘Tagovek towen, o tamwamwein wayn towen, ikaveiyons siney takalba̱lebs o tasiyas takaweins ta̱kis.’ Ga bukukines aw-wotet bwein, mo silawun bukukwakins, sinap tonen.”
Yowbad bimop ven mwasanin asisinap kalbaleb
Ven mwasanin nikines Yeisuw nawotet tawtoun, tage nag ipiyaves asisinap kalbaleb, mapun Yeisuw mo ika̱nes, ilana:

“Kuva̱lams yakamiy Kolesin o yakamiy Beteseid. Magat kweiboug tasiyas Ta̱yil o tasiyas Sidon bikines mulin naman Yowbad ma̱wana gunawotet nukukines nagein, nuwanaw mo bisimounids, bipiyaves kid asisinap kalbaleb, sona koun sewed biva̱lams-wan peinan asisinap kalbaleb, mo bipiyaves. Yakamiy gog nag. Mounid adibakeimiy igaw tutan Yowbad bimop vena babaw asisinap, tasiyas bilivatus sikalbaleb kakit, yakamiy gog avakaein.

“O yakamiy-vak Kapaneyum bukumwens kid wanakaew; nag gog, bukubus watinow, bukuneis wa̱Tum. Magat kweiboug tasiyas Sodom bikines mulin naman Yowbad, ma̱wana gunawotet nukukines, mo biva̱ges asisinap kweitan, Yowbad nag beiweiys tasiyas, bisesus ee... tut towen bisigagas. Mounid adibakeimiy igaw tutan Yowbad bimop vena babaw asisinap, tasiyas Sodom bilivatus sikalbaleb kakit, yakamiy gog avakaein.”
Yeisuw ansinap kweitan

Tut gog towen Yeisuw initoug, idibek Taman, ilana, “Tamag ya̱koum, liba̱lab natovek o ven watinow natovek ya̱koum. Kalin nuwag yak peinan nukusowm sinap tatonen. Tasiyas tassinaps nag bikakins, tage kukwatimlakes tasiyas mamagina gamagal; mo ikakins tasiyas. Peinan kaleiwag bwein wananoum.”

Yeisuw mo ilivan, ilana, “Tamag bo itam youd babaw waseg Natun yey. Tamag anmwa̱net ikakin Natun yey; o yey agumwa̱net akakin mtowen Tamag. Igaw, kalisiy beivag sivinag mo bakatimlakes; e, tasiyas mo bikakins Tamag.
“Yakamiy kunamiy moumouvit o miwotet moumouvit, kumeis waseg yey, mikabiyeiwas silma̱nin.
“Kumeis, kulabeigs kwanag waseg, mo bukukwawes agusinap yagan ma̱num; kululuwamiy mo biba̱nes sikabiyeiwas.
“Peinan kid kwanag gagab, gunawotet bwein.”
